author: GameSpot
description:
Your unwritten epic begins.

Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

Available for the first time, the Nintendo Switch 2 version will contain both the Dragon's Dogma 2 base game and the Dark Arisen Expansion content.

The Dark Arisen Expansion will also be available as separate DLC on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam.

#MHWilds #Ascendance #monsterhunter #gaming #gameplay #videogames #videojuegos #weapontypes #boostedactions

*Footage represents a game still in development. The main Monster Hunter Wilds game is required to play Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance. 

About Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance
 
Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in 2027 on PS5, XBOX Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2.

author: GameSpot
description:
Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave is a sprawling masterpiece of a strategy RPG, building upon the successes of past Fire Emblem games with new interconnected elements, expertly designed combat puzzles, and an emphasis on flexibility and choice. Nintendo and Intelligent Systems have topped themselves, making this the new high point to beat for future entries.
